content:
q07.

`web/src/connect.ts`

This file imports `createClient` from `@connectrpc/connect` and creates all the ConnectRPC service clients (e.g., `authServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `instanceServiceClient`, etc.) as exported constants.
